title: I LIFT MY HANDS

lines.text: I lift my hands to the coming king,
To the great I AM, to you I sing,
And I will serve no foreign god
Unto your name, I will bring my sacrifice.

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I lift my hands to the coming king,
To the great I AM, to you I sing,
For you're the One
Who reigns within my heart.

[Verse 2]
And I will serve no foreign god
Nor any other treasure,
You are my heart's desire
Spirit without measure,
Unto your name, I will bring my sacrifice.
